rationale: Create Noble Environmental, Inc. as the canonical U.S. vertically integrated waste-management and renewable-natural-gas platform. Apollo's May 12, 2026 primary announcement establishes that Apollo-managed funds had acquired a majority interest, and Apollo's current Infrastructure partner biography corroborates continuing board involvement and infrastructure-strategy attribution. The exact percentage, specific fund, legal vehicle and separate legal closing date are not publicly disclosed, and no later Apollo exit or signed pending sale was identified through August 12, 2026. Keep the named hauling businesses, landfills, transfer stations and RNG facilities beneath Noble rather than double-counting them as separate portfolio companies.

afterImage.description: Noble Environmental is a Pittsburgh-headquartered, vertically integrated waste-management platform serving municipalities and commercial customers across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic and Midwest United States. Founded in 2016, it provides solid-waste collection, hauling, transfer and disposal services through a portfolio of landfills, transfer stations and hauling operations, and it develops renewable-natural-gas facilities that convert landfill gas into pipeline-quality fuel. Apollo-managed funds acquired a majority interest by May 2026; the exact stake, specific fund, legal vehicle and separate legal closing date are not publicly disclosed.
